title: Onboard Helion-13B v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Sofia Alvarez
description: This PR adds onboarding assets for Helion-13B v1.0 into the model registry and wires up automated changelog/release-note generation for the new model. Motivation: Helion-13B has been validated internally and we need metadata, perf profiles, and a deterministic changelog entry to surface the model in the API catalog and in release notes. What this PR does: 1) Adds canonical metadata (model card, config, tokenizer hints) under models/helion-13b/v1.0/metadata.yaml. 2) Adds performance profiles for the common instance shapes and seq lengths used by customers (sequence lengths 128/512/2048 across A100-40G and T4 pools) under perf/profiles/helion-13b-v1.0.json. Profiles include p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, estimated cost-per-token and recommended quantization presets. 3) Hooks the automated changelog generator (scripts/automate_changelog.py) to emit a scoped entry for Helion-13B v1.0 when the registry index is updated; this avoids manual edits to CHANGES.md. 4) Updates models/index.json to add the model pointer and visibility flags. 5) Adds unit/integration tests to validate profile schema and changelog output (tests/test_perf_profiles.py, tests/test_changelog_generation.py). Implementation notes: - Perf numbers are from benchmark-lab runs (linked in commits) and include measurement metadata (tool version, workload driver). - The changelog generator now supports a "model_registry" source type and a lightweight template for release notes entries. - Tokenizer hints include recommended bpe merge counts and padding token ID conventions to avoid issues with downstream tokenization differences. Security/privacy: no customer data included; binaries are not checked in. Backwards compatibility: model index additions are additive. Migration: none required. Related: ENG-4123 (onboarding cadence), PM-781 (catalog launch).
